description: The line plot illustrates the trade-off between cost and reliability score for three different model configurations: the 3-Model Ensemble (blue line with circular markers), the 2-Model Ensemble (red line with circular markers), and GPT-4 (gold line with circular markers), as evaluated in the PromptMind Team’s work at EHRSQL-2024. The x-axis, labeled “Cost,” spans from 0 to 10 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled “Reliability Score,” ranges from 30 to 90 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 20. The 3-Model Ensemble begins at a reliability score of approximately 85 at cost 0 and declines gradually to about 73 at cost 10. The 2-Model Ensemble starts slightly higher at approximately 87 and decreases to about 72 at cost 10, showing a slightly steeper decline than the 3-Model Ensemble. GPT-4 begins at a reliability score of 90 at cost 0, drops sharply to about 67 at cost 5, and further declines to approximately 43 at cost 10, indicating a much steeper cost-reliability trade-off compared to the ensemble methods. All lines are solid and marked with circular data points at each measured cost level.
